record.oneLiner: The largest 'ostrich dinosaur', a long-legged, toothless runner.
record.description: Gallimimus was the largest known ornithomimid ('ostrich dinosaur'), from the Late Cretaceous of Mongolia — about 6 m long with long legs, a small head, large side-facing eyes and a toothless horny beak. Like its relatives it was likely feathered and built for speed.

notableFacts.text: Toothless, with a horny beak; likely feathered and fast-running.
Had large, side-facing eyes on a small, light head.
